summary: The registrant filed an 8-K reporting a routine renewal of its advisory agreement and results of its annual shareholder meeting. The Seventh Amended and Restated Advisory Agreement extends the existing arrangement with the same advisor on substantially the same terms for one additional year. The annual meeting elected seven directors with votes for each exceeding 14.2 million; a quorum of 40.34% was present. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, restructuring, or capital return. This is an ordinary administrative filing with no structural change or market-moving event. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
